{
  "dataset_name": "blood_transfusion",
  "model_family": "tree",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-2.5-pro",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "avg_donation_volume",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "The average volume of blood donated per donation event (in c.c.).",
      "value_range": [
        5.68,
        11000.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalizes total volume by frequency, providing a rate that may be more stable and discriminative than the raw volume.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V3 / V2"
    },
    {
      "name": "donation_rate_per_month",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "The number of donations per month, averaged over the donor's entire history.",
      "value_range": [
        0.01,
        22.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the intensity of donation activity. A tree can easily find thresholds on this rate.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V2 / V4"
    },
    {
      "name": "donation_consistency_months",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "The average number of months between donations. Lower values indicate more consistent donors.",
      "value_range": [
        0.04,
        98.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides an alternative view of donation frequency that may capture different patterns.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V4 / V2"
    },
    {
      "name": "is_very_recent_donor",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator that the last donation was within the last 3 months.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        1
      ],
      "feature_family": "indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a simple, powerful binary split for the model based on a key recency threshold.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(V1 <= 3, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "is_highly_frequent_donor",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator for donors with more than 10 total donations, identifying the most active group.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        1
      ],
      "feature_family": "indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Isolates a potentially distinct group of highly committed donors for the tree model to split on.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(V2 > 10, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "is_long_term_donor",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator for a donation history longer than 4 years (48 months).",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        1
      ],
      "feature_family": "indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a binary feature separating donors with a long history from newer ones.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(V4 > 48, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "donation_period_months",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "The total duration in months between the first and last donation.",
      "value_range": [
        -21.0,
        97.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the active lifespan of a donor, which can be a useful signal.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V4 - V1"
    },
    {
      "name": "overdue_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator that the time since last donation is greater than the donor's historical average time between donations.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        1
      ],
      "feature_family": "indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a binary feature identifying donors who may have lapsed based on their own past behavior.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(V1 > (V4 / V2), 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_total_volume",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed total volume donated to reduce the effect of outliers and skewness.",
      "value_range": [
        5.52,
        9.31
      ],
      "feature_family": "transformation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Compresses the range of the monetary feature, which can sometimes help tree models find better split points.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(V3)"
    },
    {
      "name": "recency_frequency_product",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "An interaction term multiplying recency and frequency.",
      "value_range": [
        1.0,
        1012.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Explicitly models the interaction between two important variables, which can save the tree model from having to learn it through multiple splits.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V1 * V2"
    },
    {
      "name": "donor_profile_quadrant",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Categorizes donors into four quadrants based on donation history length and frequency, using training set means as thresholds (V4 mean ~35, V2 mean ~5). 1: New/Infrequent, 2: Established/Frequent, 3: Established/Infrequent, 4: New/Frequent.",
      "value_range": [
        1,
        4
      ],
      "feature_family": "categorical",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a single categorical feature that summarizes a donor's high-level profile, allowing the tree to create rules for these distinct segments.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "donor_recency_status",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Ordinal status based on months since last donation. 1: Active (<= 4 months), 2: Cooling Off (5-12 months), 3: Lapsed (> 12 months).",
      "value_range": [
        1,
        3
      ],
      "feature_family": "ordinal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Buckets the recency variable into interpretable, ordered groups that are easy for a tree model to split on.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
